EmailTemplate.subject: Critical Reminder: MissingDates May Affect Commission Processing - Booking Date / Unit Launch Date
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Reminder: Sales Orders missing Booking Date
Hi {OWNER_NAME},
The following Sales Order(s) do not have a Booking Date recorded. Booking Date and Unit Launch Date are required for accurate commission calculation and timely payouts. Please update these fields as soon as possible.
If dates are not confirmed, add a short note on the Sales Order or contact Sales Operations: SUPPORT_EMAIL
Regards, Automated Reminder System — COMPANY_NAME
